swedishMassage.title: Swedish massage
description: Swedish massage is one of the most well-known and widely used classic massage techniques in the world. It focuses on relaxing the muscles, improving blood circulation, and promoting overall body regeneration. It combines various massage strokes that help release tension and induce a deep sense of relaxation.

During the massage, the therapist uses long, flowing strokes, kneading of the muscles, friction, gentle tapping, and pressure techniques. The movements are adapted to the individual needs of the client — ranging from a very gentle relaxing massage to more intense work on stiff and strained muscles.

Swedish massage is often performed using massage oils, which allow for smooth movements while also caring for the skin. It focuses primarily on areas where tension tends to build up most, such as the back, neck, shoulders, and legs.

Swedish massage is an ideal choice for anyone seeking a combination of relaxation and therapeutic benefit. It's suitable for both beginners and regular massage-goers, leaving the body relaxed, refreshed, and rejuvenated.

footReflexology.title: Foot reflexology
description: Foot reflexology is a traditional therapeutic method based on the principle that certain points on the feet correspond to individual organs and parts of the body. Through targeted pressure on the reflex points of the feet, the body's natural balance is supported, tension is released, and overall harmony of body and mind is promoted.

During the treatment, the therapist uses their thumbs and fingers to apply gentle yet targeted pressure to the individual reflex zones of the feet. The massage can be combined with relaxing strokes, gentle stretching, and skin care using natural oils.

Foot reflexology is popular for its ability to induce deep relaxation and help the body release accumulated tension. Many people seek it out as a pleasant way to rest and support their overall well-being.
Foot reflexology is an ideal choice for those looking for a gentle, relaxing treatment focused on the feet, combining traditional techniques with an enjoyable experience of deep release.

filipinoMassage.title: Filipino Massage: Traditional Pinoy Hilot
description: Pinoy Hilot is a traditional Filipino healing art passed down for generations from master to student. It is based on the belief that health arises from harmony between body, mind, and life energy. Through gentle, targeted touches, it helps restore the body's natural balance, release energy blockages, and support its capacity for natural regeneration.

The massage begins with a relaxing foot massage, which calms the body and prepares it for further treatment. This is followed by a combination of traditional Hilot techniques, including pressure point work, gentle kneading, friction, and flowing massage strokes using high-quality natural oils.

The treatment focuses mainly on the back, neck, and feet – areas where tension and fatigue most commonly accumulate. The massage also includes gentle stretching of muscles and joints, which supports their release and natural mobility. The entire ritual is completed with a soothing head massage that induces a feeling of deep calm, harmony, and overall renewal.

Pinoy Hilot is not just a massage, but a traditional healing ritual that combines touch, mindful care, and centuries-old Filipino wisdom. Its aim is to support the body's natural self-healing abilities and restore a sense of harmony, lightness, and inner peace to both body and mind.

aromaticMassage.title: Aromatic massage
description: Aromatic massage is a relaxing and harmonizing therapy that combines classic massage techniques with the beneficial effects of natural essential oils. It focuses on relaxing the body, calming the mind, and promoting overall well-being.

During the massage, selected aromatic oils are gently massaged into the skin using slow, flowing, and soothing strokes. The therapist combines light pressure techniques, stroking, and gentle kneading to help release muscle tension, support blood circulation, and induce a state of deep relaxation.
The scent of the essential oils affects not only the body but also the senses and the mind. It helps calm the mind, reduce stress, and create a feeling of harmony and inner peace.

Aromatic massage is an ideal choice for those seeking a gentle, fragrant, and soothing experience. The combination of healing touch and natural essential oils helps restore energy, relax the body, and bring a feeling of deep harmony and rest.

hotOilMassage.title: Hot oil massage
description: This massage combines the beneficial effects of warmth, high-quality oils, and therapeutic touch. Warmed oil is slowly applied to the skin, and the therapist works it in using flowing massage strokes, gentle kneading, and rhythmic pressure.

The heat helps the muscles relax more quickly, eases tension, and allows the massage techniques to work more deeply. At the same time, the oils nourish and hydrate the skin, leaving it soft and smooth.
Hot oil massage is ideal for those seeking a warm, soothing, and luxurious experience that relaxes the body, calms the mind, and restores a sense of energy and balance.

balineseMassage.title: Balinese massage
description: Balinese massage begins with gentle warming strokes using aromatic essential oils, which prepare the body for deeper relaxation. The therapist then combines long, flowing massage strokes with deep techniques, kneading, acupressure, tissue rolling, and gentle stretching. This harmonious combination helps release muscle tension, support blood and lymphatic circulation, and restore the body's natural balance.
Unlike massages focused only on specific problem areas, Balinese massage is a comprehensive full-body treatment aimed at promoting overall physical and mental well-being.

Balinese massage is an ideal choice for anyone seeking a combination of effective therapeutic care and deep relaxation. Thanks to the combination of traditional massage techniques and fragrant essential oils, it offers a unique experience that regenerates the body, calms the mind, and induces a feeling of overall harmony.

hotStoneMassage.title: Hot stone massage
description: Hot stone massage is a deeply relaxing and therapeutic treatment that combines traditional massage techniques with the use of smooth, heated stones. The heat from the stones helps relax the muscles, allows for a more intense effect of the massage strokes, and at the same time creates a pleasant feeling of calm and deep relaxation.

The massage begins with warm stones being placed on selected areas of the body, most often the back, palms, or feet, where they help warm up and release muscle tension. The therapist then combines flowing massage strokes, gentle pressure, and work with the heated stones to help release tension, improve blood circulation, and induce a state of deep relaxation.

The heat from the stones supports blood circulation, helps loosen stiff muscles, and brings a feeling of harmony and comfort. Combined with aromatic oils and mindful massage techniques, hot stone massage offers a holistic experience for body and mind.
Hot stone massage is an ideal choice for anyone seeking a warm, soothing, and luxurious massage experience that leaves the body relaxed, refreshed, and regenerated.

herbalCompressMassage.title: Bylinková masáž bylinnými měšci
description: Bylinková masáž bylinnými měšci je tradiční terapeutická procedura, při které se používají nahřáté bavlněné měšce naplněné směsí léčivých bylin. Měšce se jemně přikládají, přitlačují a masírují po celém těle, čímž pomáhají uvolnit svalové napětí, zmírnit bolest a navodit hlubokou relaxaci.

Bylinné měšce obvykle obsahují směs bylin, jako je citronová tráva, zázvor, kurkuma, kafrová limeta, kafr a další aromatické léčivé rostliny. Teplo podporuje prokrvení, uvolňuje ztuhlé svaly a umožňuje lepší působení bylinných silic.
